cells.tense: You are in the repetitions now, and something in them is getting sharper.
cells.ask: Do one sitting today, then put one line about what you found in it in front of a person who was there with you.
cells.core: The work gets done, and the sharpening happens in the doing. Enough repetitions and the shape under a thing finally shows, and you can put it in a sentence. That room stays lit by attention, and by now the light is steady.\n\nWhat you can hand over, you are handing over — the piece you finished, the thing you noticed, the order you made. One more person could be near it, though. Send the next finding to someone who was part of the making and let their reaction touch it. Your own reading of it can stand right there beside theirs. Neither has to give way.
cells.sheetLine: The repetitions are sharpening. Let someone see it.
cells.verb: cutting the pattern out of the noise
cells.place: the small lit room where repetitions refine the hand

cells.tense: You are working out every version of it before it has a chance to happen.
cells.ask: Do the next small piece and let it be rough, then say one plain sentence about where it stands without reading anyone's face.
cells.core: The thinking has outrun the work. By the time you sit down you have already solved four versions and rejected three, and the rejections cost more than the doing would have. The precision keeps landing on the whole plan instead of the one step in front of you.\n\nThe solving is not the trouble — it sees what nothing else sees. The trouble is where it is pointed. Today, put one rough mark on the page and leave it that way. Then say where the piece stands without checking anyone's face for the verdict. What you see clearly comes back when the doing is smaller than the judging, and that order is yours to set.
cells.sheetLine: The plan is getting cut before the work does.
cells.verb: cutting the pattern out of the noise
cells.place: the small lit room where repetitions refine the hand

lint.detail: "cost" — a cause given to a status; Too Little says where the person stands, never why

cells.tense: The looking has gone quiet while the practice keeps running underneath it.
cells.ask: Take one thing you have worked out and put it in front of one person in your own words today — plain, unpracticed, no rehearsal.
cells.core: The repetitions are still happening. Saying out loud what they turned up is not. What you worked out sits in the room with you and does not leave it, and the practice runs on without that part of it in the middle.\n\nMore private study will not move this. Put one finding in front of another person, in your words, at your level, less polished than it would be alone. Meaning sharpens between two people who are using it — not because the other person is a test, but because saying it out is where it becomes usable to you again. Send it today, before it gets any smoother.
cells.sheetLine: The practice runs. What it found is not going out.

cells.tense: Patterns are being read and acted on here, and you keep calling it just practical.
cells.ask: Name one piece of order you made as your own choice, out loud, to the person who benefits from it most.
cells.core: The practice is running honestly. You notice the pattern, change the setup, make the thing work, and you file it as what had to be done. You are at the desk. The choice was yours.\n\nWhat is missing is not more effort. It is one piece claimed as yours — not because it needed credit, but because that is what makes it a chosen life instead of an ordinary one. People feel something in how you handle them while you work, and it lands as warmth. Say that one of these things is your doing. The practice steadies the moment someone inside it says who set it up.
cells.sheetLine: You are already making this. Start saying so.
